page_title: VAL 1-0 SEV | Valencia v Sevilla 11/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' A cross from Fran Perez (Valencia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.
90+1' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement. Valencia will take a free kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Luis Rioja leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia).
87' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fran Perez (Valencia) replacing Javi Guerra.
86' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
86' Rafa Mir (Valencia) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
85' There's an opportunity for Pepelu (Valencia) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
84' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
82' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
81' The free kick from long range, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Gaya (Valencia) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul after Jose Gaya (Valencia) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Sevilla, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
79' Here is a change. Nemanja Gudelj is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Jose Angel Carmona can be given a rest.
79' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
78' One of the players from Sevilla times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' Pepelu (Valencia) delivers a fine ball into the box from a free kick. However, the opposition's defence make sure none of his teammates get a challenge in on the goalkeeper.
77' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jose Sanchez blows for a foul. Valencia have a free kick.
74' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Diego Lopez will be replaced by Pepelu (Valencia).
74' The substitution has been made. Rafa Mir (Valencia) has replaced Andre Almeida.
73' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is booked by the referee.
72' Kike Salas (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
71' Referee Jose Sanchez sees the trip by Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
70' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner kick, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reads it well and stops the effort.
69' What a great effort! Kike Salas (Sevilla) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
69' The attendance for today's match is 45618.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) replaces Peque.
66' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Isaac Romero is replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
66' The referee signals a substitution. Saul Niguez (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Albert Sambi Lokonga.
65' Corner kick. Luis Rioja (Valencia) is ready to send the ball into the box.

65' Diego Lopez (Valencia) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Orjan Nyland pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Valencia.

64' Hugo Duro (Valencia) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Orjan Nyland, who pulls off a comfortable save!
64' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
62' Jose Sanchez blows the whistle, Andre Almeida (Valencia) is penalised for a foul. Sevilla have a free kick.
60' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is adjudged offside.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Umar Sadiq departs the field of play to be replaced by Hugo Duro (Valencia).
57' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
55' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Peque (Sevilla). Jose Sanchez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Valencia are awarded the free kick.
52' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) will deliver the corner kick.
52' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
51' Luis Rioja (Valencia) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Sanchez signals. A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.
49' The game is interrupted as Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is flagged offside.
48' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is able to continue to play.
47' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' Javi Guerra (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' Javi Guerra (Valencia) jumps into a tackle and Jose Sanchez signals a foul. Sevilla will take a free kick near the side line.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Jose Sanchez sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+5' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez has indicated he is going to review the Valencia goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45+4' 1 - 0 Goal! Javi Guerra (Valencia) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Diego Lopez, then sends the ball inside the right post. 1:0.
45+4' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
45+3' One of the Sevilla players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Andre Almeida (Valencia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Sanchez blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Sevilla in a dangerous position.
38' The free kick from long range, taken by Valencia, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
37' A player from Sevilla takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Valencia.
36' What terrific goalkeeping by Orjan Nyland! Jose Gaya (Valencia) shoots only to the middle of the target, but with great power, forcing the keeper to pull off a difficult save.
34' A snap shot by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Giorgi Mamardashvili flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
32' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) brings an opponent down and Jose Sanchez interrupts the game. Sevilla are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
28' Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

28' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
23' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.

23' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Valencia win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
20' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Sevilla! Play can continue.

19' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sevilla players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
18' Jose Gaya (Valencia) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Sevilla have been awarded a free kick.

17' That didn't go as planned! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Giorgi Mamardashvili, who easily kept it out.
15' The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.
14' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
12' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' Valencia try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
11' A clumsy foul by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle. Valencia earn a free kick.
9' Sevilla couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
8' A player from Valencia pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
7' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) brought his opponent down. A free kick to Valencia.
6' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) causes Giorgi Mamardashvili little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Diego Lopez (Valencia) heads on.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Jose Sanchez will officiate today.
